title: The Crimson Curse Master
logline: A gifted occultist discovers that every curse he chooses to wield chooses something in him in return.

characters.name: The Crimson Curse Master
goals: choose the terms of his own transformation
fears: being chosen by the curse instead of choosing it
wounds: he learned early that belonging always had a price
contradictions: he protects others through the same violence that isolates him

locations.name: The Red Archive
locations.description: A living library beneath a ruined chapel where forbidden names stain the walls.

lore.title: The Law of Reciprocal Choosing
lore.statement: A curse cannot be commanded without recognizing the desire it exposes in its bearer.

evidence.label: The living sigil
evidence.description: A crimson mark that changes when the master lies about why he is casting.
evidence.consequence: Each lie removes one memory of being loved.

events.title: The first choosing
events.summary: The sigil answers before the ritual is complete.

scene_contracts.visual_motif: the sigil writes a second hand over his own
continuity_notes: Keep the left hand visibly unmarked until the sigil crosses the wrist.
